_readme: DATA-01 / REV-01 / REV-02 / REV-04 / V1-001 residuals: one synthetic table read by BOTH app/test/engine/parser/declined_state_cues_table_test.dart and process-ios-sms/parse_test.ts. expect: not_completed = the message reports no completed money movement (never confirmed money in either direction and no total changes; the on-device capture lands in Smart Inbox review, the server rejects it); completed_payment = a completed purchase that must keep parsing as spending; completed_credit = a genuine refund/reversal that must keep parsing as a refund (device type refund; server direction credit, type refund). src V1-RES = the residuals the release owner reopened.
